posts.name: TheySaid 4.0
posts.tagline: See how users will react, right where you build.
posts.description: Put what you’re building in front of real customers or synthetic users trained on them when you need an answer in minutes without leaving Claude, Cursor, or Jira. Nothing ships on a guess.

posts.name: Overmind
posts.tagline: Open-source platform for continuous learning
posts.description: Overmind is the model training platform for AI teams. Turn your production traces into specialised models you own, trained, benchmarked, and served.

posts.name: Orbit
posts.tagline: Stop doomscrolling. Earn every app unlock.
posts.description: Doomscrolling is free. Orbit makes it cost something. Pick a schedule and your apps lock themselves. Want back in early? Earn it: hold the orb, do squats, ask a friend, pay a little more each time, or win a shift at The Gate. Most times, you’ll stay out.

posts.name: Spacesheep
posts.tagline: Documents of the future, made by AI, read by your team
posts.description: Spacesheep (YC F26) turns any agent's work into a space: an interactive doc, live dashboard, mockup or app. Share it with specific people, your team or publicly, and collaborate on it together.

posts.name: SavorApp_AI
posts.tagline: Capture what matters and move your intentions forward
posts.description: Savor is an Intention Layer™ for thoughts that never reach your to-do list. Speak, type, or snap a photo to create a clear card in Now, Soon, or Later. Reminders bring it back when it matters. Take Action (Beta) helps you explore options, build a plan or list, and draft words you can use. Review and adjust as you go. Hand off a card or a single step, with a private chat for context. You decide what happens next. Free on iOS and Android.

posts.name: Notra
posts.tagline: Notra is a GEO tool that helps you rank in AI Search.
posts.description: Notra is a GEO tool that asks ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini the questions your buyers ask. It shows whether you appear, who appears instead and how to fix it.

posts.name: Nuvio 5.0
posts.tagline: Hand your financial admin to your AI agent
posts.description: Automate invoicing, expenses and reconciliation. Ask Nuvio’s assistant to do the work, or connect ChatGPT, Claude or your own AI agent. We’re also adding bookkeeping and tax services with accountants who already know Nuvio.

posts.name: iPad mini 8
posts.tagline: OLED, A20 Pro and IP67 in Apple's smallest iPad
posts.description: The all new iPad mini. Featuring the 8.5-inch Super Retina XDR display with OLED, A20 Pro chip, Apple Intelligence and Siri AI. Supports Apple Pencil.

posts.name: PulseDev
posts.tagline: Click any UI bug on localhost and your AI agent fixes it
posts.description: Stop describing UI bugs to your AI. Click any element on your localhost site, say what's wrong, and Claude Code, Codex, Gemini or OpenCode edits the right file. Watch it work live, then approve the diff on the page. Nothing is written until you do.

posts.name: Arcade Controller Pro
posts.tagline: A fight controller with no stick and its own screen
posts.description: A customizable all-button arcade controller with a compact layout, built-in display, hot-swappable switches, RGB lighting, and a magnetic wrist rest.

posts.name: NuPlay
posts.tagline: AI transformation, run on one self-improving platform
posts.description: NuPlay runs AI agents for enterprises in production that improve after every run. Deploy agents for retail, customer service, consumer goods etc., across voice, chat, and email, connected to your existing systems. NuPlay is built as one platform, has 5 layers which build, run and improve the agents: NuPro, NuStack, NuContext, Nupulse and NuLoop.

posts.name: Off Grid AI
posts.tagline: Private AI on your phone and computer.
posts.description: Off Grid AI runs AI models on the phone and computer you already own. Chat, read documents, ask about photos, talk out loud and make images, with the Wi-Fi off and no account. On your computer it remembers your day: meetings transcribed with no bot in the call, answers that cite their source, and replies it drafts but only sends after your yes. Your phone can use your Mac's bigger models, device to device. Free and open source on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux.

posts.name: Paddock
posts.tagline: Computers and sandboxes for your agents
posts.description: Paddock gives each AI agent its own Linux computer or a locked-down sandbox, on one VPS you own. Free and open source, MIT licensed.

posts.name: Revix AI
posts.tagline: AI code review that learns your repo's own rules
posts.description: Revix AI scans your repo, generates its own pattern and architecture rules, and reviews every pull request against them. It keeps learning as the repo changes. Each comment names its rule and is labeled by intent and severity. Free for public repos.

posts.name: OpenRadView
posts.tagline: Free, open-source viewer for your own CT, MRI and X-rays
posts.description: OpenRadView opens the DICOM and NIfTI files from your scan CD or zip on your own computer: linked axial, coronal and sagittal views, experimental 3D and measurements. Optional MCP access for your own AI agent. It is a personal research project for education and has not been clinically validated. Ask a qualified clinician to interpret your scans; do not use the app for decisions about care.

posts.name: fswitcher
posts.tagline: fswitcher replaces Command-Tab on your Mac
posts.description: fswitcher is for power users who want more out of cmd+tab. fswitcher looks, feels, and behaves exactly like you expect, but handles apps, windows, desktops, and multiple displays naturally.

posts.name: Coachare
posts.tagline: Your potential. Unlocked.
posts.description: Coachare is an AI-powered coaching platform that helps managers and leaders grow. Practice difficult conversations, performance reviews, and negotiations with an AI counterpart that challenges you in real time. Get actionable feedback, sharpen your communication, and build confidence. Coachare remembers your goals, tracks your progress, and connects you with expert human coaches when you need deeper guidance. You stay in control of what you share.

posts.name: ContextGem 1.0
posts.tagline: Decision models join LLMs to extract data from documents
posts.description: New in 1.0: decision models next to LLMs. They answer closed questions with the probability of each answer, fast and at a low cost, and a model group sends each question to the model that suits it. Also new: Docling for your files, and tools for agents.

posts.name: NINX
posts.tagline: Private On-device AI, connected tools, & creative workflows
posts.description: NINX is an AI workspace for getting things done using on-device models. Run models on your device or bring your own API key. Talk to your AI, connect apps, code with Codex, automate recurring tasks, and create videos in Studio. Capture conversations in Notes, collaborate in Rooms, and take your workflows mobile with Ningenie.

posts.name: GPT-6.1 Terra
posts.tagline: Fast, capable computer use at half the price
posts.description: GPT-6.1 Terra is OpenAI's fast, efficient model for visual reasoning, precise computer use and natural writing. It reads what's on screen, takes action across apps, and handles workday tasks like filling out forms, interpreting technical drawings and drafting proposals. OpenAI says it matches GPT-6 Astra on Agents' Last Exam at one tenth the price per token and finishes tasks over 3x faster. Available now in ChatGPT Work and Codex, and in the API as gpt-6.1-terra.

posts.name: Free AI Visibility Report
posts.tagline: Show clients what ChatGPT says about them
posts.description: Agencies won SEO deals with keyword data. AI search gave them nothing to show a client. Now it does. Enter any domain, pick ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Mode or AI Overviews and a country. In about 4 minutes you get an AI answer audit: what the engine says about the brand, which pages it trusts, and a ranked fix list. Add your logo and name, and the PDF and booking link are yours. Free, no account.

posts.name: tensemem
posts.tagline: Memory that knows what still holds.
posts.description: TenseMem is durable agent memory with a deterministic resolver, enforced cardinality, freshness-aware reads, and lasting corrections — so your agent gets what still holds, not a pile of conflicting prefs.

posts.name: Asonix
posts.tagline: Get more users for your iOS apps
posts.description: Asonix helps iOS app teams find keywords they can actually rank for, compare opportunities across 175 countries, and track rankings daily. See competitors' Apple Search Ads and Meta ads, monitor AI visibility, and connect to AI agents via MCP.

posts.name: Smart Blur
posts.tagline: Blur sensitive data automatically when you share your screen
posts.description: Hide sensitive data on any webpage before you share your screen or send a screenshot. Smart Blur blurs emails, phone numbers, card numbers, SSNs, API keys and more the moment a page loads, all on your device. No account, nothing uploaded. Pro: Share Shield turns blurring on automatically when you share from Meet, Teams or Zoom on the web. Local AI runs OpenAI's Privacy Filter model in your browser to catch names and addresses that patterns miss.

posts.name: Talìvo
posts.tagline: Paste a Google Maps link, get a website for your business
posts.description: Talìvo turns any Google Maps business listing into a beautiful, ready-to-publish website. Paste the link: we pull name, address, hours, photos and reviews, and AI builds the site. Edit it by chatting. First site free, in English or Italian.

posts.name: LemMeBuyIt
posts.tagline: The retail data layer for AI agents and resellers
posts.description: LemMeBuyIt is the retail data layer for AI agents, resellers and developers: live prices, 12-month price history, cross-retailer compare, ASIN and Buy Box mapping, and clearance signals across 100+ U.S. retailers. Free MCP server, one-click sign-in.

posts.name: SmoothCut
posts.tagline: Screen recordings that look edited, without the editing
posts.description: SmoothCut records your screen and camera, then adds zooms that follow your cursor, a smooth cursor, camera layouts, clean audio and captions for you. It runs on Mac and Windows, works offline, and you pay once. Free to try, export included.

posts.name: Kluff
posts.tagline: The company brain for AI native teams
posts.description: A collaborative workspace where employees and AI agents share context, build on each other's work, and contribute to organizational memory.

posts.name: StandIn
posts.tagline: Your personal work representative, available 24/7
posts.description: Your work is spread across email, chat, docs and code. StandIn gives everyone on your team a personal work representative that learns their work, then answers for it. When you're away, it answers teammates for you, day or night: labeled as your StandIn, with the source under every answer. It answers what's in your work and points to the right person for everything else, so every decision stays yours. Works with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack and GitHub. Free for 7 days, up to 10 people!

posts.name: krawlup
posts.tagline: Automated SEO & AI-visibility fixes
posts.description: Weekly checks of your website: speed, search rankings and how AI assistants see it, with the exact steps to fix what is wrong. Free report, no signup.

posts.name: RecordMate
posts.tagline: Free Auto-Zoom Screen Recorder for both MAC and Windows
posts.description: Create engaging screen recordings with automatic cursor-following zoom effects.

posts.name: Icon Monks
posts.tagline: 70,000+ free SVG icons for websites and apps
posts.description: Build consistent websites and apps with 70,000+ free, open source SVG icons in 6 weights and 31 categories. Download SVG, PNG, WebP or PDF, or use packages for React, Vue, Flutter, SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose. MIT licensed for personal and commercial projects. No account required.

posts.name: AppMates
posts.tagline: Meet your new App Store teammates
posts.description: Paste your link, drop your screens. Our agentsresearch your app, write the copy and design a polished, Apple-sized set in minutes.

posts.name: Flowthru
posts.tagline: One place for everything before release.
posts.description: Flowthru brings your music and the work around it into one place before release. Stream in lossless quality, control when shared files can be downloaded, keep versions and timestamped feedback together, and collect credits and agreed splits as projects take shape. Built for producers, engineers, artists and songwriters. Start with a free Essential account; paid plans unlock more storage and tools. Lossless playback requires WAV/FLAC, the Lossless setting and a compatible browser.

posts.name: Tekyous
posts.tagline: Build your tech stack visually, with real-time hints
posts.description: Tekyous is an interactive tech stack builder and tools directory for developers and founders. Start from one of 150+ curated stacks, a two-question recommendation or a blank canvas, then draw your stack as a diagram with frames, connectors, notes and your own tools. Live hints show which tools you might be missing or where they overlap, based on nearly 300 curated developer tools. Free to use.

posts.name: Autumn
posts.tagline: Making reading hot again!
posts.description: An app for readers to meet interesting readers nearby by exchanging books. No networking, just interesting conversations over books.

posts.name: XLaunch
posts.tagline: Turn your website into a narrated launch video
posts.description: Paste your product's URL. XLaunch reads your site, writes the story and a voice-over, and builds every scene in code, in your colours and fonts. Change anything by chat, export an MP4. Free preview, no card needed; $15 to finish a video.

posts.name: Bilbo: The AI trip planner
posts.tagline: Stop wasting hours planning trips!
posts.description: Type a destination and Bilbo builds a complete day-by-day itinerary in minutes: sights, food, and hidden gems, arranged into days that actually make sense on a map and respect real opening hours, so you never show up to a closed museum. Every stop stays editable, tickets and reservations attach right to the plan, and you earn passport stamps at 100+ landmarks as you travel. The AI runs on your iPhone, no account, and your trips never leave your device.

posts.name: Javo
posts.tagline: An AI sales agent trained on millions of real conversations
posts.description: Javo answers website visitors 24/7, qualifies them and hands your team the lead. One line of code. Trained on 4.6M real commercial conversations and tested on 100 real sites with 14.8M visitors: +10% revenue per visitor vs no agent, +21.6% vs a general-purpose AI in the same setup, level with human chat staff at $0.06 per conversation. Returns and complaints did not rise.

posts.name: Sourclip — Gemini Notebook Workspace
posts.tagline: The missing research workflow for NotebookLM
posts.description: Sourclip is the research workflow layer for NotebookLM. Capture from AI chats, YouTube, web pages, PDFs, Reddit and X; organize notebooks with folders, tags and search; reuse prompts with shortcuts; export to PDF, Markdown and Obsidian; and turn NotebookLM audio into a private podcast feed. Built for researchers, students, creators and power users managing serious research.

posts.name: ScrollPods for Mac
posts.tagline: Your AirPods + Your Head = A New Better Way to Scroll
posts.description: Simply look down to scroll down or up to scroll up. Enjoy the freedom to sit back, relax and scroll naturally. Whether your hands are occupied or you want to rest them or you’re looking for a more accessible way to interact. ScrollPods makes this possible for free on macOS.

posts.name: Forever Machines
posts.tagline: strange little machines that make sound
posts.description: Strange little machines that make sound. A new one is born every week. Nobody chooses it.

posts.name: Potluck
posts.tagline: The operating system for real-world social lives
posts.description: Potluck helps people organize their real-world social calendar and preserve the relationships and memories that continue afterward. Potluck brings the entire lifecycle of an offline community into one place—from planning and invitations to RSVPs, shared responsibilities, photos and memories, and the next gathering. Human behavior comes first, with AI used to make hosting easier—not replace it.

posts.name: ts-polyglot

posts.description: Import functions from C, C++ and Rust source files straight into TypeScript, with real types.

posts.name: TwoCents
posts.tagline: Grow your LinkedIn network, one comment at a time.
posts.description: A Chrome extension that writes LinkedIn comments in your voice the moment you click Comment, with a smart CRM of everyone you engage with.

posts.name: Ginta

posts.description: Write one sentence about your business and Ginta designs it, writes it and puts it online in about a minute. Forms, bookings, a shop and your own /admin just work, no setup. Or connect it to Claude or ChatGPT and build right from the chat, no Ginta credits needed.

posts.name: Elephant-Goldfish Model
posts.tagline: Draft specs with AI. Review with fresh agents.
posts.description: EGM helps you draft software specs with AI, then fresh subagents review them without the earlier conversation. Run a drift report to compare specs with code. Open source. Works with Claude, Codex, Antigravity, and ChatGPT.

posts.name: WorldDigital.ai
posts.tagline: SEO & AI Search for SMBs and Enterprises
posts.description: Digital marketing company helping SMBs, SMEs and enterprises across the US and Canada get more customers from Google, Maps and AI search: SEO, AEO, GEO, Google Ads management, content marketing and web design.

posts.name: LIMA
posts.tagline: Custom LinkedIn Feeds & Insights for B2B
posts.description: Create custom LinkedIn feeds from the companies and people you follow. LIMA reads every post and sends a daily brief and weekly report.

posts.name: Billy
posts.tagline: Write invoices Auto calculate totals Export print ready PDFs
posts.description: Billy is a free, open-source invoice editor that feels like writing a document. Click any line and start typing, let totals calculate themselves, and export professional, print-ready PDFs in seconds. With MCP support, Billy can also integrate with AI-powered workflows. Built for freelancers, indie hackers, and small businesses who want simple invoicing without the bloat. Try it at https://trybilly.tech

posts.name: Allow Copy Plus by OrangeBot
posts.tagline: Copy text from sites that disable selection and right-click
posts.description: Restore text selection, copying and right-click on websites you choose. Preview selected text, images or an area screenshot before copying or an optional AI composer handoff. Local copy and preview need no account. Free; no OrangeBot analytics backend.

posts.name: Kast
posts.tagline: Turn your LinkedIn posts into clients, not just likes
posts.description: Kast helps B2B founders know which LinkedIn posts bring clients. Plume drafts posts in your voice, each post is reviewed before publishing (hook, structure, call to action, voice), you schedule on LinkedIn and X, then Kast collects the people who engaged, with job title and company, and sends them to Instantly, Lemlist, Waalaxy or Gojiberry.

posts.name: Textfold
posts.tagline: A private text expander for Mac. No subscription.
posts.description: Textfold is a fast, native text expander for Mac. Typesig and get your signature in any Mac app. Textfold adds fill-in forms, dates and quick search. No account, no analytics, and your snippets stay plain text files you own. Free for 10 snippets; Pro is $19 once (launch price).

posts.name: spider-protocol
posts.tagline: The safety tether for vibe coders.
posts.description: For AI builders who fear bloat, bugs, and broken intent. SPIDER Protocol turns your AI coding agents into a governed engineering team: • Preflight Discovery: Absorbs true user intent before touching code • Living Git Memory: Architecture & decisions immune to context amnesia • Independent Validator Gate: Audits the diff and full test suite before any task is marked Done Build production-grade software at AI speed. 100% free & local.

posts.name: Remlo
posts.tagline: Networked notes, to-dos, and habits in one native app.
posts.description: Remlo is a native notes app for Mac, iPhone and iPad. Type a checkbox in any note and it becomes a real to-do, linked back to where you wrote it. Each day gets its own page with your note, what's due and your habits. To-dos sit on a board with stages you name. Habits show streaks and the weekly trend. Hand a to-do to an agent and send it to Claude in Terminal or the desktop app. It all lives in your own iCloud: no account, no server, works offline. Free to try for 7 days.

posts.name: SeguraDoc
posts.tagline: AI-powered protection for the inbox you already use
posts.description: SeguraDoc uses AI to look for signs of scams, impersonation and suspicious payment requests in new email. Extra protection alongside your spam filter, same inbox.

posts.name: HTML to App
posts.tagline: Turn local HTML projects into apps for your own Mac
posts.description: Turn local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript projects into standalone apps for your own Mac. Edit files, preview changes, and export with a custom icon. Add native notifications, Finder file handling, menu bar controls, and Dock animations. Embed your files or keep them linked to the original folder, with no local HTTP server.

posts.name: Tracé
posts.tagline: Maths & physics slides you can change live in class
posts.description: Tracé makes animated maths and physics slides in your browser. Type an equation and get a live graph, reveal ideas one click at a time, write your own animations in a few lines, solve a science problem, or describe a lesson and let AI build it.

posts.name: MingList
posts.tagline: Free Local Classifieds, Email Never Shown
posts.description: MingList is a free, privacy-first alternative to platforms like Craigslist or Gumtree. Built for users who value data sovereignty, it features an automatic anonymous email relay system to hide your real identity from scammers and spammers. No public profiles, no data tracking, and zero friction. Browse and post freely without compromising your personal privacy.

posts.name: Growpost
posts.tagline: Social Media Growth Engine
posts.description: Growpost adapts your content for every platform and keeps your calendar full, so you can post consistently. Start free.

posts.name: Pegasy
posts.tagline: Make your proposals as impressive as your work. Close better
posts.description: Pegasy is a proposal and closing platform for freelancers, studios, agencies and consultants. Create interactive proposals where clients can explore packages, choose add-ons, leave comments, sign and pay - all in one place. Track proposal views and engagement, and move client work from pitch to close.

posts.name: TuFit
posts.tagline: Scan any nutrition label in any language
posts.description: TuFit is the iOS calorie tracker that finally ends the “barcode not found” problem. Take a photo of any nutrition label - even in foreign languages. The AI instantly reads the calories, protein, carbohydrates and fat. No manual entry. No database limits. Works with local products, imports, and anything you find while traveling. Also includes barcode scanning, a searchable database, personalized calorie targets, Apple Health sync, favorites, and a shopping list.

posts.name: NoCodePro.AI
posts.tagline: An AI team that plans, builds and checks your app
posts.description: Describe your app in one sentence. Up to 30 AI Agent Departments ask the rest in plain English, show you the plan, then build and check it. Websites, online shops, booking pages, web and mobile apps, and we host it. Explorer is free forever. Asking is free.

posts.name: Lingo
posts.tagline: Product Catalog & PIM Software
posts.description: Lingo now brings product information and digital assets together in shareable catalogs. Connect images, videos, and documents to product details in one record. Customize fields by product type, manage market-specific information, and share curated catalogs through branded Kits and Portals. Channels help partners see what's changed so they know where updates are needed.

posts.name: Morning Masterpiece
posts.tagline: A museum masterpiece and a short story, every morning
posts.description: One public-domain artwork from the Art Institute of Chicago or The Met each morning, with a short AI-written story. Archive, AI voice, podcast, RSS, free keyless JSON API (fair use; no SLA) and Chrome/Firefox new-tab extensions. Free, no ads, no cookies.

posts.name: Carriage
posts.tagline: A typewriter for your iPhone Duo
posts.description: Everything is effortless to make and scroll past now. Carriage asks for intent. Half-fold your iPhone Duo into a typewriter: one page up top, real keys below. Typos stay, struck through, so you choose every word before you type it.

posts.name: Noa
posts.tagline: fast browser automation
posts.description: Open-source, ultra-fast browser automation on the Claude Code and Jev you already pay for. Talk to it hands-free with OpenAI Realtime voice, and schedule tasks to run on their own.

posts.name: SecondBrain
posts.tagline: Build your second brain just by talking, now on the web too
posts.description: New since our June launch: SecondBrain is rebuilt around your voice, and it now runs in your browser too. Tap and talk: it writes a clean note in your words, files it, and turns dates into events and reminders. No time given? It asks. Share links, PDFs and photos from any app, then watch it work live. Ask anything and the answer streams from your notes. Pro adds one shared memory for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Cursor over MCP. iPhone, Android and web. Free: 10 notes and 3 AI requests a day.

posts.name: Kintia
posts.tagline: Time, Culture, and the Stars
posts.description: Kintia helps you understand how the sky, time, and culture connect. Now available in 12 additional languages, Kintia combines practical astronomy, world calendar systems, and cultural timekeeping traditions in a single, beautifully designed experience. Explore the sky from any location with detailed information about the Sun, Moon, planets, stars, constellations, seasons, and celestial events.

posts.name: Inexra
posts.tagline: Show clients which posts brought in their leads
posts.description: Inexra is a workspace for social media agencies that need to prove what social earned. Every client's Instagram and Facebook DMs land in one inbox, linked to the post that started them: automatically for story replies, shares and comment replies, confirmed by a teammate for the rest. Leads and deals are credited back to that content, so the monthly report shows which posts brought in business. Plus planning, scheduling for Instagram, Facebook and YouTube, and one-link client approvals.

posts.name: RankAnalyze
posts.tagline: Find ranking gaps. Track your AI visibility.
posts.description: Go Head-to-Head with a named competitor (SWOT, pricing intel, messaging gaps), then let Competitor Radar watch them for you automatically. Geo Scan tracks whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot actually cite your brand. Brand Deep Dive ranks your whole site weakest-to-strongest; Post-Publish Audit catches live drift; Asset Audit checks drafts before they ship.

posts.name: Zarla
posts.tagline: Describe your business in a sentence. Get the whole website.
posts.description: Describe your business in a sentence and Zarla builds the whole website (copy, design, photos and SEO) in about 30 seconds. Change anything by typing. A leads inbox, booking, online quotes and invoices are built in. Free to build; pay when you publish.

posts.name: Rising Hat
posts.tagline: Connecting authors and reads
posts.description: Most websites out there cater to either the readers or the authors. Rising Hat bridges the gap between the two. Key features - 1. Authors can submit and create pages for their newly launched/unlaunched books and bring in their potential readers for free 2. Readers can start a forum on any topic/book/author and authors, and other readers can freely participate 3. Readers can give partial ratings to books + separate ratings for fiction and non-fiction books.

posts.name: BRB
posts.tagline: Quick mini-games to play solo or with your friends
posts.description: Free web app full of quick mini-games: Solitaire, Sudoku, Queens, 2048, Minesweeper, Snake and Wordle against the ranking, plus chess, Battleship, Pong and Tron with your friends. No download, and you can add it to your home screen like an app.

posts.name: Klapt
posts.tagline: Your website in, a launch video out
posts.description: Paste your website, say what you're launching in one sentence, and Klapt makes an animated launch video in your brand: script, voiceover, music and motion. Change anything in plain words. Your first video is $19, refunded if you don't love it.

posts.description: Spellbook deploys production-grade Web3 AI agents for DAOs and protocols in 48 hours. Zero private key custody, 100% full private GitHub code transfer, and fixed pricing built by a senior Web3 engineer. Protect treasuries, discord, and contracts.

posts.name: Poof: Swipe Photo Cleaner

posts.description: RapidBoard turns business data into dashboards, reports, and answers with AI. Connect spreadsheets and databases, ask questions in natural language, build visual dashboards without SQL, and share insights with your team all in one workspace.

posts.name: Scenario for Blender
posts.tagline: Open-source Blender extension for AI 3D, video and textures
posts.description: Generate 3D, video, PBR materials, audio and images without leaving Blender. Scenario for Blender is an open-source extension (GPL-3.0, 800+ GitHub stars) that imports each result straight into your open scene: a photo becomes a textured mesh at your 3D cursor, a move you describe plays on your rigged character, one line of text blocks out a room, and your camera move comes back as a photoreal shot. One click connects Claude Code, Codex or Cursor too.

posts.name: Storia
posts.tagline: Talk your idea, get a blog post in your voice
posts.description: Storia turns ideas and voice notes into blog posts, while preserving your personal style. Record or upload audio, get an AI-generated draft (with your code blocks kept intact), edit it, add a narrated version, and let Storia open a pull request in your blog's repository. Use the AI built into Storia, or bring your own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini.

posts.name: IEP Atlas
posts.tagline: Write measurable IEP goals and track progress in one place
posts.description: For special ed teachers, SLPs and IEP teams. Free bank of 4,570 measurable goals across 99 skills, a goal builder with a measurability check, and matching data sheets. Pro turns session data into progress graphs and draft progress reports.

posts.name: ShipPress
posts.tagline: Chat with your AI, get a real WordPress site on your Mac
posts.description: Free Mac app: chat with your own AI (Claude Code, Grok Build, Codex, Antigravity or Cursor CLI) and it builds a real WordPress site on your computer. Pick from hand-made themes, preview live, then publish to your host or ShipPress hosting.

posts.name: A printable vampire mystery game
posts.tagline: A printable vampire mystery in four languages
posts.description: A printable vampire mystery for 5-8 players + a Host. Question guests, trade secrets and make a final accusation. No elimination. $9.99 includes English, Russian, Spanish and German, plus A4/Letter PDFs, cards and Host worksheets.

posts.name: TailSpotter
posts.tagline: Log, look up and share every plane you spot
posts.description: Snap a plane, tag its registration and post it. TailSpotter fills in the aircraft type and airline, builds your logbook, shows what is flying overhead, and gives every tail and aircraft type its own page with photos, specs and sightings. iOS, Android, web.

posts.name: drop.
posts.tagline: Upload once. Find, use and share across your AI workflows
posts.description: I originally built drop.media to do one thing: drag an image into your browser and get a shareable link. It still does that! Now it's one media library for you and every AI agent you use. Upload from the browser, terminal or API, or let Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor save files to it through MCP. Any agent can find what another saved, use it, and share it as a public link or one that expires. Images, PDFs, video and docs, on every plan, including free. Upload once. Use it everywhere.

posts.name: PM Case Studies by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: 536 real PM case studies you can solve and get graded
posts.description: 536 product management case studies set at real companies like Spotify, Stripe, Duolingo and OpenAI. Write your answer and get it graded line by line against a rubric. 506 are built from a real write-up, so when you finish you can read how the company actually played it. Filter by level, type and company.

posts.name: NextLang
posts.tagline: Language flashcards for Anki, Mochi, Quizlet and Brainscape
posts.description: NextLang makes flashcards for learning a language, in the app you already study in. Pick your two languages (20 to choose from) and a CEFR level from A1 to C1, then start from a topic, a photo or PDF page, or subtitles. You get a native Anki or Mochi deck file with pronunciation audio inside, or a set ready to paste into Quizlet or Brainscape. Study the deck on the site before you export, or ask Claude or ChatGPT for one through the NextLang connector. Credits, not a subscription.

posts.name: LeadScout
posts.tagline: Research any company in one click, right from Chrome
posts.description: LeadScout is a Chrome side panel for B2B sales. Open any company website, click Scan, and get an AI Lead Score matched to your ICP, the decision makers, contacts from the site and a first email built on real facts. Free plan: 10 scans/month.

posts.name: Oil & Miles VIN Decoder
posts.tagline: Free VIN decoder with recalls and owner complaints
posts.description: Paste a 17-character VIN to see what the car is, the recalls listed for its model year, what owners reported going wrong, crash ratings, mpg and service bulletins. Built on federal NHTSA and EPA data. Free, no sign-up, nothing stored.

posts.name: Latte
posts.tagline: Your coding agents keep working after you walk away
posts.description: Latte keeps Claude Code, Codex, and Grok running while you’re away. Close your MacBook, and agents keep working. Approvals come to your phone through Telegram or ntfy. Guards look after battery, heat, Wi-Fi, and stuck loops, and the Mac sleeps when the work is done. Your code never leaves your Mac.

posts.name: PennyLog
posts.tagline: Track spending, set budgets & split bills, simply
posts.description: PennyLog is a free, offline expense tracker for Android. Log spends in a few taps, set budgets that warn you early, and split expenses with friends. No sign-up.

posts.name: VeltroHR
posts.tagline: VeltroHR – All-in-One HR Management Software
posts.description: VeltroHR is an all-in-one HR management software that simplifies recruitment, employee onboarding, attendance, leave management, payroll, and performance tracking. With centralized employee records, compliance support, and AI-powered insights, it helps businesses streamline HR operations and improve workforce efficiency. Contact Us: Website: https://veltrohr.com/ Ph no: +91 80 1234 5678

posts.name: Perspecto
posts.tagline: Tilt, bend or frame any screenshot in 3D, in your browser
posts.description: Perspecto turns a flat screenshot, design, logo or line of text into a 3D image, right in your browser. Tilt it to any angle with layered depth, curve it, bend it into an arc or wrap it onto a sphere. Or put it in a 3D iPhone, iPad, MacBook, iMac, Studio Display or curved monitor, with a phone screenshot next to a laptop one at real size. Export PNG, GIF, video, vector SVG, HTML or CSS. Nothing is uploaded. Free with 3 exports a day; Pro is $19 once.

posts.name: trak-yo-dolla$
posts.tagline: Track spending & net worth from CSV — free, no bank login
posts.description: Most budgeting apps want your bank credentials or a monthly subscription. trak-yo-dolla$ needs neither — export a CSV from your bank, drop it in, and your browser does the rest. Auto-categorizes transactions, tracks budgets against 12-month history, builds a net worth trend with goal projection, and previews a Life Changes hypothetical against your real spending. Optional sync encrypts your data client-side. Free, open source (MIT).
